learning_outcomes.text: Students know the different fields of activity of mechanical engineers. They understand the requirements for successful engineers derived from the presented activities, also considering gender and diversity aspects. They can apply this knowledge to decide whether a mechanical engineering degree is meaningful for them, considering their own strengths, weaknesses, and interests.

They can develop initial ideas about which of the possible profile specializations particularly suits them, what strengths they bring to it, or which weaknesses they may still need to work on intensively. Additionally, they also learn to evaluate which activities or industries will gain importance in the future.

By participating in the lectures, students get to know the discussion culture at the university and different presentation styles and can derive knowledge from them for their own presentations and targeted participation in modules.

Through participation in the Impulsbahn project and practical tasks, students gain initial experience in successfully working on and presenting tasks in a team and also learn how aspects of gender and diversity can be profitably used in teams.

syllabus_topics: Presentation of various professional activities of mechanical engineers in different industries, companies, or authorities (internal and external speakers)
Requirements placed on successful engineers by industry/professional life.
Planning of studies and preparation for a successful transition from school to university and later to professional activity.
Familiarization with the university's laboratories, meaningful internship preparation, participation, and documentation.
Insights into the research activities of the professors/mechanical engineering department.

assessment_methods.method: Active participation in the Impulsbahn (concept and execution)
Active participation in practical courses (attendance of at least 75% of practical courses)
Active participation and attendance in the lecture (attendance of at least 75% of lectures)

assessment_rules: The module is considered successfully passed without a grade upon successful completion of all three performance certificates: active participation in the Impulsbahn, active participation in practical courses (at least 75% attendance), and active participation and attendance in the lecture (at least 75% attendance).
